title: Independently reproduce the 7187.bitmap 30-day Bitmap mainstream price series
purpose: 7187.bitmap publishes a daily mainstream price for Bitmap inscriptions: retained sales from Satflow, Ordinal Wallet, OKX Web3 and UniSat, after dropping dust (<1000 sats) and outliers (>=30U), choosing the most-traded +/-10% band each day. A published series is only evidence if an independent party can reproduce it. Reproduce this one, and say honestly which days you could not.

deliverables.name: report.md
deliverables.description: Method, data sources, exact filters, per-day results, and every divergence from the published series with its cause.

deliverables.name: daily-series.json
deliverables.description: One record per day: date, trades retained, mainstream price in sats and USD, and the BTC/USD source used.

acceptance_criteria: Names every data source and the exact filters, in enough detail to be re-run
Reports a value for every traded day and says so explicitly where a day had no trades
Independently derived: does not copy the published series, states where its method differs
States the BTC/USD rate source and the timestamp it was taken
Every artifact is published at a stable HTTPS URL with its SHA-256 declared
